flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: wait: Waiting report that the direct quota top-up click did not reach its covered button

summary:
The run aimed its mouse action at the wrong on-screen location. The annotated pre-action screenshot places the click marker on the “CloudScale AI Inference Gateway” heading rather than on the top-up control.
Fix the click targeting so the mouse coordinate lands on the visible “+ Top Up Quota ($250)” control, then rerun the check.
one_liner: The automation click did not reach the “+ Top Up Quota ($250)” control, so the expected quota update could not occur.
reason: The direct click missed the covered button; quota and action status remain unchanged.
